verdict_raw:
**Not clean — a few issues found.**

1. **Modal media area looks broken (high severity).** In the "Time-Lapse Build" dialog (~x405–875, y222–535), the large preview region is a completely empty black rectangle — no poster frame, no loading spinner, no caption. At first glance it reads as a failed video load or an unfinished build. Show a static first frame, gradient poster, or "Loading preview…" state.

2. **"Label" toolbar item clipped at right edge (medium).** The last top-nav item "Label" (~x1225–1280) runs flush into the right edge of the viewport with zero padding; it appears cut off. Add right margin or make the toolbar horizontally scrollable.

3. **Sidebar bottom cut off (low).** The "Patios & Paths" section header (~y755) sits directly against the status bar with no children visible and no visual affordance that the list scrolls. Either reserve space for a partial next row (scroll hint) or pad the bottom.

4. **Ambiguous copy (low).** "Innovate" in the bottom tool row (Tape Measure / Terrain / Excavate / Analyze / **Innovate**) doesn't read as a tool name — looks out of place or like a typo for something (e.g., "Irrigate"?). Also, "Analyze" appears in both the floating Sculpt panel and the bottom toolbar — if they're different actions, differentiate the labels.

Minor notes (acceptable/expected, not bugs): modal legitimately covers the Sculpt panel labels ("Underg…", "Pro Too…", "Sun & S…"); "FPS: —" in the status bar is fine pre-render; duplicate Terrain buttons appear intentional; "5-second comprehension" is otherwise OK — the modal title/subtitle and Play/Close are clear.
